scope: PM2 table directory and nine local field/status/record UI commands with real HTTP; Excel, batch status, Sheets and execution not covered
checks: UI creates a local table through real HTTP and navigates to its records route
real competing edit preserves the draft and requires explicit reload before resaving
UI creates a field and confirms a real field mutation impact before editing
UI creates and edits a business status without changing any record status
UI creates and edits a record with real conflict reload, then explicitly changes its status
UI blocks an in-use status deletion and deletes an unreferenced status through its real operation
UI deletes the selected record after impact confirmation and retains the other record
lost real create acknowledgement survives renderer reload and recovers the original operation without duplicate insertion
five actual tabs display persisted field, status, source and record facts after UI writes
settings tab edits the actual table description through the shared form and command recovery
same-workspace real sidecar restart preserves draft, Escape protection and subsequent save
native 200 percent zoom with custom dropdown does not widen the application
full Electron restart retains table edits, business records and explicit status
two real workspace switches isolate data tables and restore original records
